description: Fires mainly when the opponent's last move is in column 3 (or 2, sometimes 1), the opponent has stones in column 2, I own stones in columns 5/6, and there are few opponent stones in column 3 or of mine in columns 0/4. Each stone adds only a little, so there is no sharp pattern. In very short games a reversed pattern also fires: I hold column 0 and they hold columns 3/4.
effect: None measurable: forcing it to its max or to zero left move probabilities unchanged (to 0.01) in 5 positions.
notes: Layer 0, tiny activations. Per-stone weights come from single-stone act substitutions averaged over 6 positions (not fit to labels). Dev F1: p1 0.28, p2 0.27, p3 0.35, p4 0.43, p5 0.28 (reversed mode at all lengths over-fires), p6 0.43 (P 0.36, R 0.54, AUROC 0.76). Simulation share nan (a perfect reader recovers -72%, so the unit has no causal effect). The reversed short-game mode and the diffuse additive behaviour suggest a mixture or random-like direction. Synthesis reaches 0.011 vs dev max 0.009.
